title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 404) reviews: Teacher arrested after school banditry drama sparks panic

content.rendered:
A teacher at Ijaiye Ojokoro Junior College in Lagos has been arrested after a drama presentation on banditry reportedly caused panic among students who believed a real attack was taking place.

While police described the incident as an attempt to create content around insecurity, colleagues of the teacher insist it was an approved educational programme, sparking debates about accountability, communication, and how sensitive security issues should be taught in schools.
